subject: RSVP Rescue & Handoff: Architect Demo Wave - playbook + ownership
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finovate.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: RSVP Rescue & Handoff: Architect Demo Wave - playbook + ownership

Quick context: our Architect Demo wave (July 14) is seeing a flattening RSVP curve after initial seed. Field has opportunity to rescue high-value invites and convert waitlist. I sketched a short "RSVP Rescue" playbook for the reps and local field leads; attaching the draft.

Goals for this thread:
- Confirm who owns the rescue cadence (Jonas / Monica / field reps)
- Approve final segmentation to prioritize (canary list, VIP architects, partner referrals)
- Share tracking links and confirm UTM mapping so we can attribute conversions in the pipeline.

Immediate asks:
1) Jonas — quick signoff on the field outreach cadence below (3-touch: email, follow-up call, final calendar pulse). Can you own the rep script?
2) Monica — can CS/SEs take the VIP architect list for 1:1 touches? If yes, I will route the list and a one-click CTA.
3) Samir / ACME — can you do a 10-min push to your internal architect distribution for seats? We will mark special access codes for your referrals.

Attachments: RSVP-rescue-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook), tracking-links-sheet.csv (UTM mapping), canary-segmentation-list.csv

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finovate.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP Rescue & Handoff: Architect Demo Wave - playbook + ownership

Thanks — looks concise. I can own the rep script and the call templates. Quick notes:
- Recommend rep cadence = 3 touches over 6 days (Day 0 email, Day 2 call/voicemail, Day 5 calendar nudge).
- For canary list, prioritize by "last engagement" and company size (>100 engs). I flagged 150 rows in the spreadsheet — see column H.
- We should include a short CMS snippet for reps to drop into Outreach sequences (subject lines and 1-liners included).

I'll upload the rep script as "rep-script-v1.docx" by EOD and will add Outreach snippets to the tracking sheet.

Jonas
Senior Field Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finovate.ai>
Cc: ACME Platform Team <platform@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP Rescue & Handoff: Architect Demo Wave - playbook + ownership

Looping in ACME ops. Priyom — we can take the VIP architect list for 1:1 touches. Outline:
- CS/SEs will get 20 contacts each; ask = quick discovery call (15 min) + reserved seat code.
- We will personalize using last-seen-product tag and a 1-liner about inference scale (we'll use the CMS snippet Jonas provides).
- Timeline: outreach starts Tue 7/6, follow-ups Tue 7/13 for final calendar push.

Attachment: I exported a cleaned VIP list as canary-segmentation-list-clean.csv (attached).

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

From: Samir Patel <samir@finovate.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP Rescue & Handoff: Architect Demo Wave - playbook + ownership

Thanks for the heads-up — happy to help. I can send a short internal note to our architect distribution with a reserved seat code (ACME-ARCH-RED). Two asks from our side:
1) Can you provide a one-sentence value prop tailored to platform architects (scale, cost, KV cache improvements)?
2) Please confirm the registration link with UTM so we can reconcile.

If you can drop both into the tracking-links sheet I will schedule the send for Thu 7/8.

— Samir

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finovate.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP Rescue & Handoff: Architect Demo Wave - playbook + ownership

Perfect — final alignment below and action owners (tracking sheet updated):
- Rep script & outreach snippets: Jonas (deliverable: rep-script-v1.docx, due 2027-07-07 17:00 PST)
- VIP 1:1 outreach: Monica + CS/SEs (deliverable: canary-segmentation-list-clean.csv — distributed 2027-07-06)
- Partner internal push: Samir (deliverable: partner-send with code ACME-ARCH-RED scheduled 2027-07-08)
- UTM + final reg link: Priyom (I updated tracking-links-sheet.csv: reg_link=https://redwood.ai/register?utm_source=acme&utm_campaign=architect_wave&utm_medium=partner)

Two operational notes:
1) Make sure RSVP patching in the registration DB is enabled — Jonas, please confirm Outreach dedupe so partners don't double-send.
2) Reporting: I'll run a mid-week check (Wed 7/13) and pulse daily on the dashboard for conversions.

Attachments: RSVP-rescue-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook) — final version attached for field.

Thanks everyone — will close the handoff after Jonas uploads the rep script.

Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143
